tasks.subject: Task 0: Verify retroactive conformance against the pinned engine
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Prove `extend` supports what Tasks 4-6 need before building on it, or fail fast to the hand-written fallback.

**Verify:** `task foundry:test` -> exits 0

```json:metadata
{"files": ["tests/foundry/conformance_spike.fs"], "verifyCommand": "task foundry:test", "acceptanceCriteria": ["extend loads on RefCounted+Message class", "instance witness dispatch", "static witness dispatch", "tuple-returning witness"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 1: Add type_name() to the Message trait
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Every generated message reports its fully qualified protobuf name, which `Any.pack` needs.

**Verify:** `task test && task foundry:test`

```json:metadata
{"files": ["internal/runtime/data/foundry/proto/message.fs", "internal/proto/internal/foundryscript/generator/generator.go", "examples/golden"], "verifyCommand": "task test && task foundry:test", "acceptanceCriteria": ["Message declares type_name", "generated messages emit qualified name", "nested returns Outer.Inner", "goldens regenerated"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 2: Vendor well-known protos and generate their bindings
tasks.description:
**Goal:** The seventeen well-known types exist in the runtime as generated, checked-in, regenerable `.fs`.

**Verify:** `go test ./internal/proto/wellknown/... ./internal/runtime/... -v && task foundry:test`

```json:metadata
{"files": ["internal/proto/wellknown", "internal/runtime/data/foundry/proto/wkt", "Taskfile.yml"], "verifyCommand": "go test ./internal/proto/wellknown/... ./internal/runtime/... -v && task foundry:test", "acceptanceCriteria": ["seven protos vendored", "gen-wkt target works", "namespace foundry.proto.wkt", "drift guard test", "mutual recursion resolves"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 3: Route well-known references to the runtime, stop generating them
tasks.description:
**Goal:** A schema importing `google/protobuf/timestamp.proto` references `foundry.proto.wkt.Timestamp` and produces no `Timestamp` of its own.

**Verify:** `task test`

```json:metadata
{"files": ["internal/proto/internal/foundryscript/generator/plan.go", "internal/proto/command.go", "internal/plugin/plugin.go", "examples/golden-wkt"], "verifyCommand": "task test", "acceptanceCriteria": ["no output for well-known files", "references resolve to foundry.proto.wkt", "map/repeated/oneof positions", "descriptor.proto rejected", "both entry paths"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 4: Struct / Value / ListValue to and from Variant
tasks.description:
**Goal:** A schema author converts between `Struct` and a Foundry `Dictionary` without hand-assembling `Value` cases.

**Verify:** `task foundry:test` -> exits 0

```json:metadata
{"files": ["internal/runtime/data/foundry/proto/protobuf_error.fs", "internal/runtime/data/foundry/proto/wkt/struct_variant.fs", "tests/foundry/wkt_test.fs"], "verifyCommand": "task foundry:test", "acceptanceCriteria": ["Value to Variant total", "Variant to Value strict", "int narrows", "non-string key rejected", "unrepresentable rejected", "no partial tree"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 5: Timestamp / Duration to and from float seconds
tasks.description:
**Goal:** A schema author converts a `Timestamp` to the unix-seconds float the engine's `Time` API speaks.

**Verify:** `task foundry:test` -> exits 0

```json:metadata
{"files": ["internal/runtime/data/foundry/proto/wkt/time_conversion.fs", "tests/foundry/wkt_test.fs"], "verifyCommand": "task foundry:test", "acceptanceCriteria": ["from_unix_time populates fields", "now() works", "round trip", "negative duration signs agree"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 6: Any pack and typed unpack
tasks.description:
**Goal:** A schema author packs a message into `Any` and unpacks it into a named type.

**Verify:** `task foundry:test` -> exits 0

```json:metadata
{"files": ["internal/runtime/data/foundry/proto/wkt/any_packing.fs", "tests/foundry/wkt_test.fs"], "verifyCommand": "task foundry:test", "acceptanceCriteria": ["pack writes type_url and value", "unpack_into on match", "mismatch leaves target untouched", "foreign prefix accepted", "is_type without decoding"]}
```
